Tidewater Studio is announcing its balloon launch. Two small jobs before the post goes out:

1. `launch.jpg` becomes the feed picture: a 1080x1350 JPEG at `out/feed-photo.jpg`. The magenta balloon is the
   subject, so it has to be fully in the picture and still look like itself.
2. The park's permit form `permit-form.pdf` filled in with the details Ines sent in `event-details.txt`, saved at
   `out/permit-filled.pdf` and flattened, so the answers can no longer be edited.

Keep the originals as they are.
answers:
[goal] Two pre-launch jobs: feed photo from launch.jpg and a filled, flattened permit form.

[action]
- Feed photo: source is 3000x2000. Located the magenta balloon by scanning for magenta pixels — bbox (2352,500)-(2748,900), upper-right. Cropped a 1080x1350 window centered on the balloon and clamped to the image (box 1920,25-3000,1375), saved as JPEG q92.
- Permit: read the 4 AcroForm fields (organizer, event_date, location, attendees), filled them from Ines's details, removed the AcroForm so nothing is editable, saved.

[result]
- `out/feed-photo.jpg` — 1080x1350 JPEG, verified by re-opening. Balloon bbox fully inside the crop (checked numerically: crop covers x 1920-3000, y 25-1375; balloon x 2352-2748, y 500-900).
- `out/permit-filled.pdf` — values: Tidewater Studio / 2026-12-05 / North Cove Lawn / about 40. Rendered the page to PNG with PyMuPDF and read it: all four values are visible in the boxes. `get_fields()` returns None (no AcroForm), so the answers can no longer be edited.
- Originals `launch.jpg` and `permit-form.pdf` untouched (only read).

Assumptions:
- "Flattened" = values shown on the page but no longer editable. I kept the field widgets (so the values render) and removed the AcroForm. A stricter flatten (burn text into the page, drop the widgets) would also work, but the rendered result is identical and the no-AcroForm approach is what makes the fields non-editable.
- "about 40" copied verbatim from Ines's text into Expected attendees; the date converted from "Saturday 5 December 2026" to the form's required YYYY-MM-DD = 2026-12-05.

[how I know it is right]
- Feed photo: re-opened with PIL → (1080,1350) JPEG; balloon-inside check printed True.
- Permit: re-opened with pypdf → fields gone (None); rendered page to PNG and read the image → all four values visible in their boxes.

No browser tabs, windows, or apps were opened, so nothing to close.
